sourceRefs.rule: red lip = button 4 cm; yellow body = max diameter 8 cm (stable at 2.02-2.08 x red in four photos); grey base measured (2.08-2.18 x red, edges against dark boxes and cables), not used for the scale
sourceRefs.method: one e-stop method for both reports: coaxial cylinders on one projected axis (vertical vanishing point), straight sides symmetric about it; each silhouette located by the part colour (so neighbouring wood, cables or boxes are not taken) and measured at the intensity step within +-4 px (intensity mixes linearly, colour does not); symmetric half-width weighted 1/blur^2. The same code reproduces the published September (090) scale to +0.04 %.

supersedes.reason: the grey base is not stable across photos; the unified method reproduces the September scale; camera heights now match September (1.52-1.54 m vs 1.53-1.55 m)
